name: WECA strategic active travel network synthesis

metadata.notes: Corridor-level synthesis for WECA plus strategic external gateways. Lines are planning corridors, not designed alignments. Primary A-road corridors are treated as the default strategic backbone; quiet-lane and greenway corridors show reach and parallel-route opportunities.

properties.corridor_name: A4 Bristol to Bath via Keynsham
properties.provenance_notes: Prototype corridor geometry sketched from known settlement centres, A-road names, NCN/greenway context and SATN-style settlement reach logic.
properties.uncertainty_notes: Indicative corridor only. Requires route audit, highway boundary review, traffic-speed context and land/constraint checks before any design conclusion.
